Are you tenacious, pragmatic, with a keen sense of humor? You just might be an Idealist.

At Idealist Consulting, we help organizations grow through Salesforce implementation, managed services, and custom application development. We are innovators and problem-solvers committed to global progressive action; delivering innovative technical solutions to empower organizations working on some of the world's most important causes and aspire to do no harm and benefit all.

As a part-time Enterprise Project Manager you will take charge of guiding client projects from inception to completion. You'll be responsible for translating client needs into technical requirements, managing project resources, and ensuring seamless communication between the client and our team.
 
This is a part-time contracted 1099 position.
description:
Are you tenacious, pragmatic, with a keen sense of humor? You just might be an Idealist.

At Idealist Consulting, we help organizations grow through Salesforce implementation, managed services, and custom application development. We are innovators and problem-solvers committed to global progressive action; delivering innovative technical solutions to empower organizations working on some of the world's most important causes and aspire to do no harm and benefit all.

As a part-time Enterprise Project Manager you will take charge of guiding client projects from inception to completion. You'll be responsible for translating client needs into technical requirements, managing project resources, and ensuring seamless communication between the client and our team.
 
This is a part-time contracted 1099 position.

lists.content:
• Guide full project life cycle from requirements gathering to solution design and development, testing, and deployment
  • Steering complex Enterprise-level implementations through various stages of development and deployment.
  • Support translation of client needs into technical requirements
  • Join and lead client-facing discovery sessions.
  • Maintain and update Story Navigator as the central repository of project configuration, design, documentation, and user feedback
  • Assist in quality testing prior to user testing
  • Create and actively manage implementation schedules, project deliverables and milestones to ensure effective completion of project milestones, control project scope and mitigate risks.
  • Coordinate client and Idealist Consulting project team meetings and communications, utilizing prescribed project management tools and platform to ensure continuity in communication and project quality
  • Produce quality project deliverables, including kickoff presentations, project plans, status reports, budget burn reports, client requirements, design documentation, and deployment plans
  • Work closely with client project team to identify, nurture, and guide client team
  • Collaborate with Client Success Team and Service Delivery management as needed to resolve project or client communication roadblocks
  • Proactively manage multiple, concurrent projects

• Baseline:
  • 3-7 years experience in a similar role
  • Minimum certification: Salesforce Admin Certification
  • Understanding of Nonprofit Cloud (NPC) (Certification preferred)
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills - including translation of technical requirements to non-technical individuals
  • Project management experience
  • Familiarity with PROSCI and ADKAR
  • Understanding of nonprofit technology projects
  • Ability to engage in multiple projects at one time
  • Experience managing with both Waterfall and Agile software development methodologies
  • Creative and analytical thinking with a passion for solving customer problems with software solutions
  • Experience in Enterprise-level Implementations, demonstrating a track record of successfully steering complex projects through various stages of development and deployment
  • Extra Credit:
  • 2+ Salesforce administration with strong declarative design skills and the ability to deliver customer-driven solutions
  • Proven experience with NPSP and NPC
  • PMP or other related Certification is a strong plus
  • Experience managing projects or engaging in projects with technical and cross-functional components
  • Previous experience working with nonprofits, experience working in fundraising and program management is a plus
  • Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud certifications a plus 
  • Team leadership experience

description:
Are you tenacious, pragmatic, with a keen sense of humor? You just might be an Idealist.

At Idealist Consulting, we help organizations grow through Salesforce implementation, managed services, and custom application development. We are innovators and problem-solvers committed to global progressive action; delivering innovative technical solutions to empower organizations working on some of the world's most important causes and aspire to do no harm and benefit all.

As a Salesforce for Nonprofits: Solution Architect you will lead the delivery of Salesforce implementation projects through thoughtful assessment of client requirements. You’ll envision system design, data structure, integrations, UI/UX to support user stories.

lists.content:
• Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform and product ecosystem
  • Provide sales opportunity support including product demos, sales discovery, and advice on estimates as requested.
  • Articulate and document the benefits and risks to a solution’s feasibility and functionality to clients and sales reps
  • Contribute solution expertise to RFI and RFP responses as assigned
  • Lead Solution Architecture and project solution vision in the Idealist Way 
  • Lead discovery process with clients using Story Navigator to determine ERD, need for custom code, and application integrations
  • Plan sprints and support data mapping
  • Oversee UAT and contribute to test script documentation and bug fixes as needed
  • Develop and document user instructions and administrative maintenance requirements for use in our custom-coded Salesforce solutions for clients
  • Conduct project audits, architecture reviews, and provide cure recommendations as assigned
  • Advise on best practices and support service delivery quality and practice consistency through the creation of process templates, mentorship and knowledge sharing. 
  • Stay up to date on third party applications and report on high level functionality, use case, and integration capacity
  • Follow and understand new Salesforce product and technical capabilities resulting from product releases and acquisitions, make recommendations for R&D
  • Some travel to meet with clients and participate in pre-sales engagements may be required
  • Maintain target utility 70%

• Minimum 3 years Salesforce certified Advanced Administrator or Platform Developer
  • Minimum 5 years experience as a Business Analyst
  • Extensive experience with Enterprise technology implementations
  • Understanding of key concepts that support user focused design and design thinking
  • Proven ability to design and optimize business processes and integrate business processes across disparate systems
  • Excellent client-facing written and oral communications skills
  • Previous experience collecting and working from user stories preferred
  • Minimum 1 year experience using story mapping methodology to capture business requirements
  • Minimum 1 years leading CRM implementation project teams
  • Minimum 3 years experience utilizing Agile and Waterfall project management methodology
  • Experience with data migrations from third party solutions to Salesforce
  • Desire to learn new things and take on challenges

• Equitable total compensation package with base salary and monthly utilization awards
  • Humane work weeks and a Hybrid Work Policy that allows you to work from wherever you are (as long as there’s an internet connection)
  • Healthcare benefit package options that cater to all lifestyles
  • Generous paid time off plans that grow over time
  • Paid volunteer time to encourage community involvement and a service mindset
  • 401k employer match and short term leave available with tenure
